# 🧯 Incident Postmortem

## Summary
- Incident ID:
- Severity:
- Start/end:
- Incident lead:
- Services affected:

## Customer impact
Describe confirmed impact. Separate verified facts from estimates.

## Timeline
Use timestamps with timezone.

## Detection and response
How was the incident detected? What actions were taken?

## Root cause
Explain technical and process contributors without assigning personal blame.

## What went well / poorly
Record evidence-based observations.

## Corrective actions
| Action | Priority | Owner | Due date | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Follow-up
Link logs, deployment, issues and runbooks. Remove secrets and personal data from attachments.
